name: iNaturalist
description: iNaturalist API provides access to citizen-science species observations, identifications, taxa, places, and users. Developers can query public biodiversity data, submit observations with OAuth2, and integrate species occurrence records into research apps, educational tools, and conservation platforms.

auth.details: JWT via OAuth then GET https://www.inaturalist.org/users/api_token; send Authorization: Bearer <JWT> (24h expiry). Required for PUT/POST and some private GETs; many reads work unauthenticated. Does not grant a documented higher rate limit.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no paid plans. Exact numeric quotas not cleanly published as fixed ~100 unauth / higher auth figures; use response rate-limit headers and current docs/community guidance.

rate_limits: Official guidance: ~1 request/second and ~10,000/day (Recommended Practices); swagger Terms also cite max ~100/min (prefer ≤60/min) and 10k/day. Excess may get HTTP 429; media downloads have separate caps. Auth has no documented higher quota.
use_cases: search species observations by taxon name or location
look up taxon taxonomy and common names
get observation details with photos and identifications
list nearby wildlife observations for a map
fetch place boundaries used in iNaturalist
query user observations for citizen-science apps
